title: Longest Palindromic Substring
summary: Return the longest contiguous piece of a string that reads the same forwards and backwards.

tests.explain: Both "bab" and "aba" have length 3; either is accepted.
A single character is a palindrome.

hints: Every palindrome has a center: a single character for odd lengths, or the gap between two equal characters for even lengths. Checking all substrings directly costs O(n³).
Try each of the 2n - 1 centers and expand outward while the characters on both sides match. Each expansion stops at the first mismatch.

Write expand(l, r) that moves l left and r right while s[l] === s[r], and returns the length. Call it with (i, i) and (i, i + 1) for each i, remember the best start and length, and slice the answer at the end. Any longest palindrome is accepted.

complexity.time: O(n²): 2n - 1 centers, each expanding up to n / 2 steps
